date_basis: Explicit RG09/05/2024-32541/7-a current pediatric somatropin/somatrogon heading effective17/05/2024; not the initial enactment date of underlying growth criteria. Earlier dates review-only.
scope: Necessary standard velocity/bone-age and explicit SGA case1/case2 comparisons only. Printed age bands are clinician-recorded source categories, never derived from decimal chronological age. Puberty is explicit clinical assessment, never inferred from sex/age. Organic/surgical and neurosecretory paths remain review-only and never inherit standard conditions. All successful necessary checks retain partial eligibility review.
remaining_clinical_requirements: Systemic disease, height deficit, duration/author of monitoring, laboratory GH tests, source-specific diagnostic confirmation, reports, puberty biological definition and specialist judgement remain unproven by these comparisons. SGA source cases are selected explicitly rather than guessing AND/OR between cases.
